37000.commentary: (DNt) niccasaññan'ti saṅkhārā niccā'ti evaṃ pavattaṃ viparītasaññaṃ. diṭṭhi-cittavipallāsa-ppahānamukhen'eva saññāvipallāsa-ppahānan'ti saññāggahaṇaṃ, saññāsīsena vā tesam'pi gahaṇaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

examples.text: anicc'ānupassan'ādikā satt'ānupassanā sayaṃ tassa tassa paccanīk'aṅgavasena pariccattāhi niccasaññ'ādīhi vimuttattā tadaṅgavimuttī'ti saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti.
anicce niccasaññino, dukkhe ca sukhasaññino, anattani ca attā'ti, asubhe subhasaññino, micchādiṭṭhihatā sattā, khittacittā visaññino.

examples.text: ucc'āvacā niccharanti, dāye aggisikh'ūpamā, nāriyo muniṃ palobhenti, tāsu taṃ mā palobhayuṃ.
aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgato kho pan'assa bhoto gotamassa mukhato ghoso niccharati, vissaṭṭho ca, viññeyyo ca, mañju ca, savanīyo ca, bindu ca, avisārī ca, gambhīro ca, ninnādī ca.
yathāparisaṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sarena viññāpeti, na c'assa bahiddhā parisāya ghoso niccharati.
idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā

37084.commentary: (ANa) āgāḷhā paṭipadā'ti gāḷhā kakkhaḷā lobhavasena thiraggahaṇā. nijjhāmā'ti attakilamath'ānuyogavasena suṭṭhu jhāmā santattā paritattā. majjhimā'ti n'eva kakkhaḷā na jhāmā majjhe bhavā.

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, nijjhāmā paṭipadā? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco acelako hoti mutt'ācāro, hatth'āpalekhano…

37085.synonym: anucintayati, anuvicāreti, anuvitakkayati, anuvitakketi, paccavekkhati, paṭisañcikkhati, vitakkayati, vitakketi, samavekkhati
37085.commentary: (NIDD1a) pajjhāyatī'ti bhusaṃ cinteti. nijjhāyatī'ti anekavidhena cinteti. apajjhāyatī'ti tato apagantvā cinteti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ayaṃ gaṅgā nadī mahantaṃ pheṇapiṇḍaṃ āvaheyya, tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso passeyya nijjhāyeyya yoniso upaparikkheyya.
so kāmarāgaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.

37087.synonym: anuvicinanta, anuvicintayanta, anuvitakkayanta, anuvitakkenta, cintenta, paṭisañcikkhanta, vitakkenta

examples.text: tassa taṃ passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññ'eva khāyeyya, tucchakaññ'eva khāyeyya, asārakaññ'eva khāyeyya.
tathā paññāpitānaṃ nicchayakaraṇena nijjhāpetā. tathā nijjhāyitassa atthassa paṭipattipayojanavasena pekkhetā. tathāpaṭipanne paṭipattiphalena pasādetā.

37090.meaning2: having meditated (on); having reflected (on); having pondered (over)

37091.synonym: niṭṭhāpita, niṭṭhita, paripūrita, pariyosita, vusita, vūsita, samatta
37091.commentary: (DHPa) niṭṭhaṅgato'ti imasmiṃ sāsane pabbajitānaṃ arahattaṃ niṭṭhaṃ nāma, taṃ gato patto'ti attho.

examples.text: niṭṭhaṅ'gato asantāsī, vītataṇho anaṅgaṇo, acchindi bhavasallāni, antimo'yaṃ samussayo.

37092.meaning1: come to a conclusion; reached surety; not in doubt (about)

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akaṅkhī hoti avicikicchī niṭṭhaṅ'gato saddhamme. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati. tassa aññatarena gāḷhena rog'ātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti, akaṅkhī vat'amhi avicikicchī niṭṭhaṅ'gato saddhamme'ti.

37094.meaning2: sick person who will never recover

37096.meaning1: reached the conclusion; came to the realization

examples.text: evam'eva kho ahaṃ, bho, yato addasaṃ samaṇe gotame cattāri padāni ath'āhaṃ niṭṭham'agamaṃ, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho'ti.
yathā yathā me, āvuso, bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti uttar'uttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ tathā tath'āhaṃ tasmiṃ dhamme abhiññāya idh'ekaccaṃ dhammaṃ dhammesu niṭṭham'agamaṃ, satthari pasīdiṃ

37097.meaning1: in this case a conclusion should be drawn; here the understanding could be reached

examples.text: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni na c'eva sutte otaranti na vinaye sandissanti, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, addhā, idaṃ na c'eva tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa, imassa ca bhikkhuno duggahitan'ti.

37098.meaning1: reaches a conclusion; is sure about

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso kusalo bherisaddassa. so addhānamaggappaṭipanno bherisaddaṃ suṇeyya. tassa na h'eva kho assa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā, bherisaddo nu kho, na nu kho bherisaddo'ti! atha kho bherisaddotv'eva niṭṭhaṃ gaccheyya.
seyyathā'pi, bho, kusalo nāgavaniko nāgavanaṃ paviseyya. so passeyya nāgavane mahantaṃ hatthipadaṃ, dīghato ca āyataṃ, tiriyañ'ca vitthataṃ. so niṭṭhaṃ gaccheyya, mahā vata, bho, nāgo'ti.
niṭṭhaṅ'gato asantāsī, vītataṇho anaṅgaṇo, acchindi bhavasallāni, antimo'yaṃ samussayo.
